# Aksh Finserv

> Aksh Finserv is an AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributor (ARN-121998) at 363, Powai Plaza, Hiranandani Gardens, Powai, Mumbai 400076, working with families since 2004. It helps families organise their investments, insurance, loans and goals, and distributes mutual funds, NPS and insurance. It is not a SEBI-registered investment adviser; content on this site is general information, not personal investment advice.

The site's main resource is the Family Money Guide, a free guide to putting a family's money in one place: what you have, what it's for, when you'll need it, who the nominees are, and who at home can find it. The One-Page Test is a free two-minute self-check with no sign-up.

## Guides and tools

- [The Family Money Guide](https://akshfinserv.net/family-finances): how an Indian family can organise its investments, insurance, loans, goals, nominees and family access, plus what to update when life changes, how to help parents, and what to do after a death in the family
- [The One-Page Test](https://akshfinserv.net/one-page): seven questions about where a family's financial records are, not how much they hold
- [How to put your family's money on one page](https://akshfinserv.net/insights/family-money-on-one-page): a step-by-step method with an illustrative example
- [SIP calculator](https://akshfinserv.net/calculators/sip): what a monthly amount could grow to at a rate you choose (illustration only)
- [Retirement calculator](https://akshfinserv.net/calculators/retirement): roughly how large a retirement corpus may need to be (illustration only)
- [Loan vs liquidate calculator](https://akshfinserv.net/calculators/loan-vs-liquidate): the cost of borrowing against mutual funds compared with redeeming them
